c74object.name: el.waveshape~
c74object.digest: Chebyshev polynomial waveshaper and harmonic distortion processor
c74object.description:
el.waveshape~ is a Chebyshev polynomial waveshaper and distortion processor. It generates a transfer function lookup table by summing user-specified Chebyshev polynomials, representing harmonic weights starting with the 0th harmonic (DC component). Incoming audio signals between -1.0 and 1.0 are mapped directly through this transfer function. Because waveshaping is non-linear, higher input amplitudes will generally produce richer spectra. Input signals that vary in amplitude will work well here.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Audio input signal to be waveshaped (clamped between -1.0 and 1.0), and control message inlet (list, mute).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Waveshaped audio output signal.

inlet.description: Audio signal input to be waveshaped, as well as configuration messages (list, mute).

outlet.description: The processed, non-linear waveshaped audio output signal.

objarg.name: harmonic-weights
objarg.description: Initial list of numeric weights defining the Chebyshev polynomial transfer function, starting with the 0th harmonic (DC component). Up to 256 harmonics are supported.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set harmonic weights for transfer function
method.description: Specifies the relative weighting of Chebyshev polynomials for the transfer function. The first value represents the 0th harmonic (DC component), followed by weights for harmonics 1, 2, 3, etc. (up to 256 harmonics). The resulting lookup table is automatically normalized between -1.0 and +1.0.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal waveshaping resumes.

method.name: signal
method.description: Incoming audio signal (clamped between -1.0 and 1.0) used to index into the transfer function table.
